name: YNHPROP
recent: YNH Property 于 2026 年 11 月 24 日召开第 24 届年度股东大会，除第 5 项普通决议因 Dato' Dr. Yu Kuan Chon 于 11 月 19 日辞去董事职务而撤回外，其余决议均获通过。Dato' Dr. Yu Kuan Chon 以无法查阅账目为由辞任非独立非执行董事，董事会则指此事与一项物业转移调查有关。公司正为 2 月到期的 1.7 亿令吉伊斯兰债券赎回安排资金，计划通过出售 Hartamas 资产筹集 1.05 亿令吉。
notable: Dato' Dr. Yu Kuan Chon 于 2026 年 11 月 19 日辞去非独立非执行董事职务。
公司计划通过出售 Hartamas 资产筹集 1.05 亿令吉，用于 2 月到期的伊斯兰债券赎回。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 24 日举行第 24 届年度股东大会，除第 5 项决议外所有决议均获通过。
risks: 董事 Dato' Dr. Yu Kuan Chon 因无法查阅账目而辞职，董事会指此事与一项物业转移调查有关。
公司面临伊斯兰债券储备短缺，需为 2 月到期的 1.7 亿令吉伊斯兰债券赎回安排资金。
公司出现清盘 / 接管 / 限制令 / 特别管理人等公告（2026 年 10 月 27 日）。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，公司营收为 6,914,559 令吉，环比下降 47.9%，同比下降 81.5%；净亏损为 53,015,665 令吉，净亏损率为 766.7%，较上一季度的 95.7% 扩大。

recent_en: YNH Property held its 24th AGM on 24 November 2026, where all resolutions were passed except Ordinary Resolution 5, which was withdrawn following the resignation of Dato' Dr. Yu Kuan Chon as a director on 19 November 2026. Dato' Dr. Yu Kuan Chon resigned as Non-Independent Non-Executive Director citing blocked access to accounts, while the board linked the resignation to a property transfer probe. The company is arranging funding for a RM170 million sukuk redemption due in February, targeting RM105 million from the sale of its Hartamas asset.
notable_en: Dato' Dr. Yu Kuan Chon resigned as Non-Independent Non-Executive Director on 19 November 2026.
The company plans to raise RM105 million from the sale of its Hartamas asset for the February sukuk redemption.
The company held its 24th AGM on 24 November 2026, with all resolutions passed except Resolution 5.
risks_en: Director Dato' Dr. Yu Kuan Chon resigned citing blocked access to accounts, while the board linked the resignation to a property transfer probe.
The company faces a sukuk reserve shortfall and needs to arrange funding for a RM170 million sukuk redemption due in February.
The company made an announcement on winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator (27 October 2026).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM6,914,559, down 47.9% QoQ and 81.5% YoY; net loss was RM53,015,665 with a net margin of -766.7%, widening from -95.7% in the previous quarter.
